        "Read both complete four-path owned diffs: original3510 is243lines and backout3519 is241lines, including the complete66-line wrapper addition/deletion. Exact inverse ledger confirms all four file blobs are restored. The backout reason only says it should not have been pushed; no technical failure cause is inferred.",
        "The proposal gives message creation its own SafeListener override so both outcomes call OnStopCreate with the correct status rather than relying on optional fallible-interface lookup. It moves remote-create/header-populated/new-key conversions into methods and constructs the owned wrapper before detached spawn. The single-response check precedes the borrowed items[0] access. This is a scoped guarded access, not a ban on unwrap or a new indexing rule.",
        "The proposal changes completion diagnostics: success uses let _ on on_success and discards a returned OnStopCreate error; the prior/backed-out code logs that callback failure. Failure dispatch still logs when its failure callback returns an error. Remote creation, local header population and stop notification remain separate fallible stages; a remote-created item does not establish completed local storage.",
        "Accepted current code is in protocol_shared and uses IExchangeMessageCreateListener::OnRemoteCreateFinished(status,id), with an empty ID on failure. Current CreateItem returns the new ID through into_success_arg, and the shared DoOperation handler warns if on_success returns an error. This later contract does not use the old header-return/new-key callbacks. The common owned-wrapper proof was already read in3509 and is reused unchanged.",
        "Manual Rust checks preserve state-specific header parameters, concrete remote/local callback names, reason comments for parsing original MIME content, and scalar/native-string SAFETY claims. No test or assertion is added. Generated binding ownership, native storage completion and actual callback failures were not exercised. No Rust/C++ compile, copy, server, database, build, lint or runtime check ran.",
        "Backout3519 restores pre3510 state, which still includes earlier3509 header/sync wrappers until their later backout3520. It does not itself remove the whole six-patch stack.",

This is the retained procedural reason, not a verified crash or memory-safety failure.
